title: Agent errors still show raw work ids for WorkAncestorNotOpen and a recovery cause's child
outcome: Agent errors still show raw work ids for WorkAncestorNotOpen and a recovery cause's child
acceptance: On CLI text, CLI JSON and MCP, a WorkAncestorNotOpen refusal names the affected item by work_ref instead of details.work_id, and a WorkCompletionRecoveryRequired cause that names a child (RequiredChildUnsealed) names it by short reference in the message, reminders and details, while the raw host/core envelope keeps its ids; a test covers both

completion.summary: Agent ancestor refusals name affected work by short ref; RequiredChildUnsealed errors name the child by short ref in message, reminder and details, preserving raw core and host ids. Landed and installed after independent acceptance.
